scientific_boundary: The proof scope requires an honest periodic square-cell decomposition so the facewise regular-neighborhood construction is embedded.
Tiny or short-period quotient degeneracies are covered by the separate finite oracle, not silently absorbed into the local-cell proof.
The result identifies the lattice matching observable as an ambient-H1 rank imbalance; it does not identify a local CFT field or prove a selection rule for V_(2,2).
No closed form for the square-site threshold follows from the homological balance identity.

sources.role: ambient torus homology image as the homological-percolation observable
modern bridge between 4-connectivity, 8-paths, and digital topology

theorem_scope: periodic square-site quotients whose unit square cells embed with four distinct corners
